item.text:
## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The invitation password path should also enforce the new minimum: it still accepts passwords shorter than twelve characters. This review read every changed file and all existing validator tests; signup and reset have coverage at eleven and twelve characters. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
Raises the signup and reset password minimum from eight to twelve characters and updates their boundary tests. Also adds `review.txt`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Apply the new minimum to invitation passwords — An eight-character password such as `xxxxxxxx` still passes the invitation validator despite the stated twelve-character requirement. The changed constants leave `app/invite.py:1` at eight, and `tests/test_invite.py:8` still expects acceptance at that length. — Users setting passwords through invitations can bypass the new minimum with eight- through eleven-character passwords. — Fix: Update the invitation validator and its boundary tests to enforce twelve characters.

## Suggestions
(none)
